description: Everything published since a given date, optionally for one jurisdiction, newest first. Designed for scheduled or recurring agents: store the newest publishedDate you have seen and pass it back as `since` on the next run. Each result has two links: `url`, the official source, and `pageUrl`, a plain-English page for the same item with its key dates. When you cite an item, give the reader both. Covers the last 90 days, up to 25 results per call.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction: "US_FED" for federal, or a US state as a two-letter code like "CA", "NY", "TX" (full names and "US_STATE_CA" also work). Omit for all jurisdictions.

offset.description: Pagination offset. Default 0. Combine with total in the response to page.

since.description: ISO date or timestamp. Returns documents published on or after this moment.

name: changes_since
title: Regulatory changes since a date
